description: This file contains the implementation of the Upgrade controller class within the OpenCart admin tool namespace. It manages the upgrade process, including checking for the latest version, downloading update files, installing updates, and handling related AJAX requests.

classes.name: Upgrade
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing the software upgrade process within the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the upgrade overview page, set titles, breadcrumbs, and load header, footer, and view.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Handles the AJAX request to download the latest version, check permissions, and return JSON response with download status or errors.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process for a specified version, including downloading, extracting, and replacing files, with JSON response indicating success or errors.
